value.rationale: The first failing size within a natural irreducible nonreversible Markov family is exactly six; the sharp recovery root and distinct safe step windows at eight states identify a concrete nonmonotone maximum-principle defect of a commonly used L-stable high-order integrator. This is a complete small-size phase boundary and reproducible structural benchmark, beyond the generic RK order barrier; no unsupported generalization to arbitrary generators or full higher-dimensional windows is claimed.
